description: Save the current session's goal, progress, touched files and recent commands to a .claude-checkpoint file in the project, so a new session can resume after a crash, /clear, or context limit without re-exploring. Call after finishing a milestone, before risky operations, and when the conversation is getting long. Git branch, HEAD and uncommitted files are captured automatically.

decisions.description: Key decisions, constraints, and dead ends to avoid repeating.

goal.description: The primary objective of the session, in one or two sentences.

mode.description: replace: overwrite the checkpoint. merge: update the existing one, appending commands, decisions and files.

modifiedFiles.description: Files you changed, with an optional note. Uncommitted git changes are detected automatically; list files here to annotate them or to include committed ones.

nextSteps.description: Concrete next actions, in order, for whoever resumes.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path of the project. Defaults to the client's workspace root or the server's working directory.

recentCommands.description: Recent significant terminal commands (builds, tests, migrations), oldest first, with exit codes and a short note on the outcome. Secrets are redacted automatically.

summary.description: Where things stand: what works, what is broken, what you were in the middle of.

tasks.description: Sub-goals with their status. In merge mode, tasks with the same description are updated.

name: save_session_checkpoint
title: Save session checkpoint
